message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl_fuzzer && grep -n "fuzz_send_next_response" curl_fuzzer.cc && echo "---" && sed -n '400,470p' curl_fuzzer.cc` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The fix changes:
```
if(sman->response_index > TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES ||
```
to:
```
if(sman->response_index >= TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES ||
```

The bug is in `fuzz_send_next_response` in `curl_fuzzer.cc`. The check uses `>` instead of `>=`, so when `response_index` equals `TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES` (which is 11), the check `sman->response_index > TLV_MAX_NUM_RESPONSES` is false, and it accesses `sman->responses[11]` which is out of bounds (the array has indices 0-10).

Let me look at the `fuzz_send_next_response` function in the vulnerable code to understand the exact flow.
